definitions.gloss: following a precedent; carrying on unchanged
definitions.explanation: Continuing or adopting a policy, method, or practice that was established by a predecessor, without significant changes. Often used in political and organizational contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{前任者|ぜんにんしゃ}→前任者：19225_zenninsha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方針|ほうしん}→方針：04871_houshin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{踏襲|とうしゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To follow the policy of one's predecessor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経営|けいえい}→経営：02740_keiei⟧⟦{方針|ほうしん}→方針：04871_houshin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{踏襲|とうしゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}した→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧。
examples.english: The new president announced that he would carry on the previous management policy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{伝統|でんとう}→伝統：09585_dentou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ただ→ただ：01613_tada⟧{踏襲|とうしゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦だけでなく→〜だけでなく：18373_dakedenaku⟧、⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}わせて→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧⟦{変|か}えて→変える：01089_kaeru⟧いくこと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: It's important not just to follow tradition but also to adapt to the times.

notes:
Compound of {踏|とう} (to tread upon) + {襲|しゅう} (to succeed to, to inherit). Literally "to walk in the same footsteps." Formal in tone, frequently used in news, politics, and business.

Can carry a neutral or slightly negative nuance depending on context — sometimes implying a lack of originality or unwillingness to reform.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{方針|ほうしん}→方針：04871_houshin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{踏襲|とうしゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (follow a policy)
- ⟦{路線|ろせん}→路線：11341_rosen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{踏襲|とうしゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (continue a course/direction)
- ⟦{伝統|でんとう}→伝統：09585_dentou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{踏襲|とうしゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (follow tradition)
- ⟦{前例|ぜんれい}→前例：11790_zenrei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{踏襲|とうしゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (follow precedent)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{継承|けいしょう}→継承：13841_keishou⟧: inheriting and carrying on (more positive, emphasizes succession)
- ⟦{受|う}け{継|つ}ぐ→受け継ぐ：06700_uketsugu⟧: to inherit, to succeed to (broader, everyday usage)
